records.note: Mentura as Naive's platform adapter (Z-4): the tests it runs, passed to Naive with NAIVE_PLATFORM_ADAPTER. Verified by mentura adapters verify mentura
A Mentura kit (EE-071): an enhanced package or command, with its automations (M-12) or its agent workflow (U-3). Naive finds kits through NAIVE_KITS and reads them as data (schema/kits.mjs)
A research cell (confidential, Mentura): state(subject, time, aspect) for a venture, function and frame. Stored as JSONL under RESEARCH_STORE (gitignored), later Neon Postgres.
A source the research engine read, with credibility factors 1-4 (confidential, Mentura). Stored as JSONL under RESEARCH_STORE (gitignored), later Neon Postgres.

A claim for a research cell; confidence and verdict computed in code by packages/platform/research/credibility.mjs (confidential, Mentura). Stored as JSONL under RESEARCH_STORE (gitignored), later Neon Postgres.
Ties a research claim to a source with a locator and an optional short quote (confidential, Mentura). Stored as JSONL under RESEARCH_STORE (gitignored), later Neon Postgres.
